description: Find operators (sellers) we FIRST OBSERVED selling recently — their earliest observation in our data falls in the window. An observation signal, NOT confirmed market entry: sparse sampling can surface a long-present seller the first time we see them. Different from top_expanding_operators (existing operators adding brands). Use when the user asks 'new sellers this month', 'who just started selling', 'newly seen operators', or any question about emerging/newly-observed sellers.

earliest_seen_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD lower bound on earliest-seen date.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

min_brands.description: Minimum brands to filter out trivial sellers (default 5).

since_days.description: How far back to look (default 30, max 180).

name: find_new_operators
